WITH invoice_metrics AS (
  SELECT invoice_number,
         AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_line_product_cost,
         AVG(derived_total_cost / NULLIF(product_price, 0)) AS invoice_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
), overall_ratio AS (
  SELECT AVG(invoice_ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM invoice_metrics
), kept_invoices AS (
  SELECT m.avg_line_product_cost, m.invoice_ratio, o.avg_ratio
  FROM invoice_metrics AS m
  CROSS JOIN overall_ratio AS o
  WHERE m.invoice_ratio > o.avg_ratio
)
SELECT AVG(avg_line_product_cost) AS avg_product_cost,
       AVG(invoice_ratio) AS avg_ratio,
       AVG(invoice_ratio - avg_ratio) AS avg_excess_overall_ratio
FROM kept_invoices

assumptions.assumption: A zero product_price makes that line's ratio undefined and is ignored, like a missing value; the SQL uses NULLIF to avoid division by zero. Invoice averages and the overall average are unweighted averages over their non-missing values.
